necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness that are concerning for potential arrhythmia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency. Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture intermittent rhythm disturbances that may be contributing to these symptomatic episodes and to guide further management of the valvular disease. This clinical indication supports the medical necessity of CPT 93229 despite the denial based on reason code CO-197.
